user_question: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospital points
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform hospital point geometries into the census tract CRS so the binary spatial join uses compatible coordinate reference systems.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the hospital vector layer to EPSG:26918. Preserve all hospital attributes and point geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Assign containing census tract to each hospital
workflow_steps.purpose: Perform a point-in-polygon spatial join between the projected hospitals and Centre County census tracts, retaining the hospital records and appending the tract identifier.
workflow_steps.instructions: Spatially join the hospital points to the census tract polygons using containment. Retain one output record per hospital and append the census tract identifier field from the tract layer. Ground the relevant tract identifier field from runtime schema evidence; do not assume or rename field names in parameters.

requirements.scope: The hospital point layer and census tract polygon layer used by join_hospitals_to_containing_tracts must have compatible CRSs.
The census tract input must contain a field that identifies each tract, and that field must be appended to each hospital record by the spatial join.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Vector Analysis B
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector joins, dissolves, grouped aggregations, attribute joins, and buffering. Vector operations consume GeoPackage inputs. The service does not convert formats, repair invalid geometries, or reproject inputs automatically.

skills.name: Vector Aggregation and Joins
skills.description: Performs polygon dissolves, feature aggregations, spatial joins, attribute table joins, and spatial buffering on GeoPackage layers.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for spatial joins. Requires projected CRS for metric buffer.
other: Accepts GeoPackage (.gpkg) vector format only. Rejects GeoJSON or Shapefiles.
Accepts CSV tables for attribute join operations.
